verdict.rationale: Increase provides webhooks, real-time decision events, and a List Events API that let a developer's own server react automatically and asynchronously to payment/card events (e.g., real-time authorization decisions, ACH/wire lifecycle updates), which supports building background automations. However, this requires the user to host and run their own listener/automation logic—Increase itself doesn't offer a hosted automation/scheduling engine or AI-agent-specific tooling for autonomous background tasks. Missing for 10: a hosted automation/orchestration layer, native scheduling/cron-like triggers, and explicit AI-agent integration for autonomous background execution.
